description: Purchase one verification (a causal verdict on whether a model switch holds quality on YOUR production traffic). This action consumes one verification — fetch the current price from GET /api/pricing before spending. No verdict, no charge. Returns a Stripe checkout URL for a human (or payment-capable agent) to complete, plus claim instructions when the purchase is anonymous. This tool does NOT charge anything itself — payment happens on the returned URL. Requires an API key with the 'write' scope.
name: metrx_buy_verification
